race.description: Sunshine Coast Turf Club July 26 Hcp (C2)
race.comment: A few in-form runners come together but none are going as well as GRAM (1) who tackled a similar race here three weeks ago and got the cash by the barest margin. Continues to raise the bar this prep and he gets a great chance to bring up the hat trick. THRASH A BULLY (9) is another with wins at her last couple. Sat just off the pace then closed a shade too well over this course and distance a fortnight back. Awkwardly drawn but if things fall into place she is good enough to test this field. MISS FORCE (3) led and gave a sight but was claimed near the line at this track and trip recently. Fitter for two runs back and with luck from a wide draw can play a key role. The speedy YOWERI (4) has won his last couple, both over 1100m. Doubt he will get any peace up front today but he is going too well to dismiss. JIMMYINTHEJUNGLE (2) is a good fresh performer who is not out of contention coming off a six-month lay-off.
